verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official `poly` command-line tool that makes files searchable and scriptable from the terminal. It ships inside the desktop app and has a commands reference (search, cp, wget). An official agent skill teaches agents to compose `poly` commands, and the Claude Code plugin runs `poly memory summary`, which suits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: poly is Poly's command-line tool: your files, searchable and scriptable from the terminal. It ships inside the desktop app—there's no separate download.
cp — Copy between local disk and Poly, or within Poly ... wget — Download a URL straight into Poly
teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing `poly` commands.
When Claude Code starts, the plugin runs poly memory summary against the local Poly app.
